# Assumption of Moses Chapter 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Joshua's Lament Over Moses

---

**1** And when Joshua had heard all these things, he tore his garments and fell at the feet of Moses and began to weep for him, saying:

**2** O Moses, why have you comforted me? And how shall I be able to continue without you?

**3** Who will provide food for this multitude? Or who will be their shepherd?

**4** Who will have compassion on them and guide them on the way they should go?

**5** Who will pray on their behalf when they sin and will make intercession for them?

**6** Behold, the land will be distributed to them, and they will fix their hearts on good things.

**7** But when they are in the land they will sin and will not observe the commandments of the Lord, just as their fathers did before them.

**8** And who will make intercession for them and ask pardon for their sins?

**9** For their God will be angry with them and will not spare them.

**10** He will destroy their root from the land and will scatter them among the nations.

**11** How then will they be able to endure among the nations? For they will not rule over them.

**12** How will they be able to cry to the Lord their God, who is the Most High with power over all?

**13** How will they be able to remain in the land if they have no one to make intercession for them?

**14** For behold, you are departing from us, and where will those who fear God find comfort?

**15** For what nations will not celebrate when they hear of your going away, and will not say: let us go up against them and wipe them from the earth?

**16** For Moses, the holy prophet of God and his servant, has departed from among them.
